newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 4.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 4.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Col Ltd A$18.87 (-0.28)

Speculation about Foster's launching a share buy-back and placing the 51 percent of its shares owned by BHP and Asahi is likely to ratchet up a notch with comments from Asahi's President in a Reuters interview that Asahi would decide on its ties with Foster's soon.

Rural Property Trust will trade for the first time since its manager, Rural Asset Management, resigned yesterday before it could be pushed aside at a unitholders meeting scheduled for later in the day.

Vengold Inc said on Wednesday it has agreed to buy 7.8 million shares in Lihir Gold Ltd for C$19.38 million, increasing its stake in the Papua New Guinea gold miner to 8.4 percent from 7.5 percent. Vengold said the acquisition would be funded by a prospectus offering of 9.45 million shares at C$2.05 a share.

Carpenter Technology Corp said late on Tuesday that it has agreed to buy the structural ceramic component and powder business of ICI Australia Ltd for US$16.5 million. ICI Australia later said the sale was independent of its selective partial buy-back and sale of ICI Plc's stake in ICI Australia.

F H Faulding & Co Ltd said it planned to make a US$12 a share merger offer for its listed U.S. subsidiary, Faulding Inc. Faulding said it will fund the merger by means of a rights issue. It gave no details of the issue.
